definitions.explanation: A weight, usually a long bar of metal or stone, laid on paper to keep it flat and still. An essential tool in Japanese calligraphy.

examples.japanese: {文鎮|ぶんちん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧。
⟦{半紙|はんし}→半紙：18325_hanshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{文鎮|ぶんちん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{押|お}さえる→押さえる：02021_osaeru⟧。
examples.english: To hold the calligraphy paper down with a paperweight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{筆|ふで}→筆：03601_fude⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{硯|すずり}→硯：06124_suzuri⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{細長|ほそなが}い→細長い：06670_hosonagai⟧{文鎮|ぶんちん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The calligraphy set contains a brush, an inkstone, and a long thin paperweight.

notes:
Japanese schoolchildren meet the {文鎮|ぶんちん} in calligraphy class, where a long bar holds the top edge of the ⟦{半紙|はんし}→半紙：18325_hanshi⟧ (calligraphy paper). Also used for any decorative paperweight on a desk.

- {文鎮|ぶんちん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{押|お}さえる→押さえる：02021_osaeru⟧: to hold down with a paperweight
- {文鎮|ぶんちん}{代|が}わり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in place of a paperweight
